description: This source file contains a benchmarking class 'ArrayDeserializeBenchmark' that compares the performance of deserializing an array of 'MyVector3' objects using different serialization libraries including Orleans, MessagePack, Protobuf, and System.Text.Json. It defines setup procedures, serialization payloads, and benchmark methods for each serializer, and is intended to measure and compare deserialization performance.
